summary: Adds rows below the data already on a sheet.
description: Writing starts in column 1 of the first new row, and the sheet is grown by exactly as many rows as the matrix has. Unlike `Sheet#appendRow`, which takes one row at a time, the whole block is written in a single call.
A cell whose text starts with `=` is written as a formula, not as text — the same rule the editor follows.

params.values: A matrix of rows: one array per row, all of the same length.
params.options: `afterFrozenRows` puts the new rows immediately below the frozen ones instead of at the very top.

returns: the same sheet, so calls can be chained.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is not a sheet.
throws.TypeError: the values are not a matrix with rows of equal length.
